objective: Drive awareness and sales for the Classic 6.5 Inch Limited Edition Hoverboard among campus riders.
persona_rationale: The hoverboard's fun features, speed, style, and accessible price point with EMI options directly address the campus-rider's needs and concerns for campus commutes and social appeal.
key_message: Glide across campus with ease and style, making every hop between classes fun.

proof_points.claim: Reach up to 15 km/h for quick campus hops.
Play your favorite music on the go with built-in Bluetooth speakers.
proof_points.source: It comes with built-in BlueTooth speakers (description)

proof_points.claim: Ride with confidence thanks to auto-balancing and wide anti-slip foot pads.
proof_points.source: auto-balancing system levels itself on the ground

proof_points.claim: Get the Classic 6.5 for ₹16,999, with EMI options starting from ₹817/month.
proof_points.source: price: ₹16,999 (scraped data) and EMI Options Starting from ₹817/month (description)
